source: CUS_P_02-compressed.pdf, proposed ground floor P.12 / page 13
purpose: Approximate VR visualisation for scale/layout only, not a construction model.
orientation: Start outside the East/window side looking toward the rooms. Bedroom appears on user's right; bathroom/utility on left.
control_notes: model is oriented so default camera looks from the East/window side toward the house without rotating the whole scene
left stick movement uses camera world direction
press X on left controller to invert stick Y if browser/controller maps it backwards
rig y position is locked to 0; WebXR local-floor supplies headset height
